ideas.title: Automated Partner Billing Exports
ideas.description:
Generate recurring financial reports per DBA with automated delivery to partners

**Findings**: Partners currently request manual billing breakdowns. Automation would reduce admin overhead and improve partner satisfaction. Similar features in competitor platforms show 40% reduction in support tickets.
dependencies: Stripe API integration for billing data

aiStudio.nextSteps: Survey partners on preferred report formats, estimate Stripe API usage costs, prototype PDF templates

ideas.title: White-Label Provisioning Wizard
ideas.description:
Script-based wizard to spin up new DBA projects with zero-code setup

**Findings**: Current DBA setup requires manual configuration across Vercel, DNS, analytics, and environment variables. Automation would enable faster partnership launches and reduce setup errors. Estimated 80% time savings (4 hours → 45 minutes).
drivers: Enable non-technical team members to provision DBAs

aiStudio.nextSteps: Spike on Vercel/DNS API capabilities, design wizard UI flow, estimate API rate limits and costs, create rollback strategy

ideas.title: Name Audit Service for Clients
ideas.description:
Productize the name vetting automation as a standalone service offering for external clients seeking business name validation

**Findings**: The name-vetting.js automation provides significant value beyond internal DBA naming. Many startups, entrepreneurs, and agencies need comprehensive name validation but lack access to multiple APIs and scoring expertise. Packaging this as a service could generate recurring revenue and position Software Factory as a naming authority.
drivers: New revenue stream from existing automation
Low marginal cost per client audit
Differentiates Software Factory with unique offering
Builds authority in business naming space
Cross-sell opportunity for full app development
dependencies: Pricing model for different audit tiers
Marketing landing page and case studies
Terms of service and legal disclaimers
API key cost management and billing
Customer support workflow for audit questions

aiStudio.nextSteps: Validate market demand through customer interviews, estimate API costs at scale, prototype client-facing report format, research competitor pricing (LegalZoom, Trademark Engine)
